## R83 T06 verdict: HOLD

**Blocking: 1 evidence gap in T-5. Blocking product defects: 0. Should_fix: 4.** T-1 through T-4 meet the reviewed contract. R83 closes the legacy rename defect that blocked R82. The approved pre-merge goal aligns with P009 P-5 and BR06, and the retained source CLI run demonstrates the measurement, comparison, and grounded retrospective workflow in a synthetic project. Exact-R83 whole-suite and independent dynamic completion were unverified at review time, so T06 closeout remains on hold. **Freeze verified.** HEAD and manifest base both resolve to `441c1d3783807e0e62c2deaa25ed9c189ac2f48e`. All 45 product paths, file SHA-256 values, and patch pre/post blob IDs matched. The patch passed a read-only reverse applicability check. Its SHA-256 is `0d47961fd4d52b703ffa4e17a1a751f89ea5f3b1d0bd02a4360388a37d34a150`, also the hash in the recorded first-stage pass. Only `harness.ts` and `team-metrics.test.ts` differ from R82. Project records, backlog, brain, and memory changes sit outside the product manifest. ### Earlier blockers and their disposition

- **R80 remains FAIL, blocking 2 and should_fix 1.** Its independent **293/293** and whole check **1,339 passed, 0 failed, 17 skipped** stand. R81 fixed the two original cases. Ordinary in-project security output reaches the legacy index commit, while adoption and known private paths are rechecked before staging. Completed tasks read `TASK.md`, `TASK-CLOSE.md`, and declared evidence from the selected Git candidate. The R81 control rejects ignored working-only proof and accepts it after manual inclusion. I also verified that T03’s existing `evidence/final/host-results` link resolves to a `040000` tree at the base. [R80 contract](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/projects/P009_261123_프로젝트_맞춤_에이전트_팀/tasks/T06_팀_측정과_회고/evidence/impl-contract-r80.json) · [293-test result](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/projects/P009_261123_프로젝트_맞춤_에이전트_팀/tasks/T06_팀_측정과_회고/evidence/claude-r80-dynamic.json) · [R81 controls](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/test/team-metrics.test.ts:2113)
- **R81 remains FAIL, blocking 1 and should_fix 3.** Its independent **28/28** stands. Its whole run recorded **1,340 passed, 1 failed, 17 skipped**, with R27 catching the lost outside-project guard. R82 restored that guard and bound `PRE-REVIEW.json`, attempt proof, and waiver proof to the same Git tree. Each omitted proof fails with HEAD and working evidence preserved, then passes after manual inclusion. Pre-review proof still requires a safe relative path and a nonempty regular file. [Candidate reader](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/harness.ts:1142) · [Pre-review rules](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/pre-review.ts:59) · [Three R82 controls](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/test/team-metrics.test.ts:2182)
- **R82 remains FAIL, blocking 1 and should_fix 3.** Its whole check was **1,361 total, 1,344 passed, 0 failed, 17 skipped**, and its independent focused run was **33/33**. R83’s finish scope guard passes `--no-renames` so Git reports both the source deletion and destination addition. Other pending-path callers retain the default. The recorded red run reproduces the outside-to-inside escape. The R83 focused run shows that an in-project rename reaches the legacy index commit and an outside-to-inside rename stops before that commit, preserving HEAD and the command’s staged rename. R27’s outside modification and R81’s ordinary output both pass their respective controls. **Should_fix (4).** The team finish path still skips shared-index freshness and active dashboard validation. The R83 index preview reports both indexes current, while the validation gap remains. The three R82 maintenance findings also persist: detailed aggregation guidance is scattered despite the new summary table, request-coverage fingerprint transfer is manual, and unsupported Git commands can surface a generic tree-check error. The security actor wording now covers `owner` and existing `user`. The guide records actual Git 2.55.0 coverage and leaves older Git and `commit.template` behavior unverified. **Observation limits.** The frozen product evidence and grounded synthetic retrospective are available. P009’s T06 close still records `막힘`, and the worktree lacks a P009 project-level retrospective and finish receipt. Human identity, collection completeness, real workload effects in both repositories, and BR07’s field retrospective remain unknown. **T08 stays on hold for owner field work after main merge and installation.** I read the supplied first-stage judgment first and used a separate read-only review context. I ran no tests and made no edits, installation, merge, or external communication.
